name: Ola FutureFactory Expansion
evidence_quote: Ola Electric has commenced phase 2 expansion at its Pochampalli FutureFactory in Krishnagiri district with an investment commitment of ₹2,400 crore, creating over 2,100 jobs for skilled technician and assembly line workers.

name: Siemens Gamesa Wind & Hydrogen Unit
evidence_quote: Siemens Gamesa in partnership with renewable developer ACME has broken ground on a ₹1,800 crore turbine component and green hydrogen equipment manufacturing unit in Tuticorin SIPCOT Phase-2.

name: IFS Cold Chain Processing Terminal
evidence_quote: IFS Logistics has commissioned its 150-acre integrated agro-processing and cold chain terminal in Krishnagiri with an initial capital outlay of ₹350 crore.

name: Ather Energy Battery Expansion
evidence_quote: Ather Energy announces recruitment drive for 800 battery pack technicians across Hosur manufacturing facility.

name: ACME Green Ammonia & Hydrogen Plant
evidence_quote: ACME Cleantech commences civil works on ₹5,200 crore green hydrogen and ammonia plant in VOC Port industrial zone, Thoothukudi.
